scope: Checked CPU int32 matrix multiplication, including immutable tensor results through nested worker tasks.

semantics.types: Rank-two CPU int32 operands [M,K] and [K,N] produce int32 [M,N]. Mixed numeric element types and known shape mismatches are diagnosed; dynamic inner mismatches fault.
semantics.products_and_order: Every product is sign-extended to int64, checked against int32 range and narrowed before accumulation. The existing balanced-adjacent contraction tree checks and narrows each addition too. Odd tails are carried unchanged.
semantics.overflow: Product, pair and later-level overflow fault even if later cancellation would yield an in-range mathematical total. Late-cell failure publishes no partial tensor. Source matmul location is preserved.
semantics.empty: Zero output rows/columns skip contraction work and do not size scratch from the unused inner dimension. Zero inner extent produces zero-filled output. Native inputs must still have valid checked dimensions/byte counts.
semantics.implementation: Initial serial scalar row/column loops reuse one int32 scratch buffer and the existing reduction tree/checked scalar operations. Float32 SIMD/tiled matmul code remains unchanged.
semantics.ownership: Input aliases and strided views remain immutable. Scratch/result storage uses existing invocation ownership; task result leases survive worker/core/invocation destruction.
semantics.task_faults: Nested workers, cached awaits, parent tensor reuse and a new parallel group use existing TaskError.Fault/Arithmetic propagation. Scheduler/runtime/checked invocation ABI unchanged.
semantics.remaining: GPU integer arithmetic, additional numeric types and conversions remain gated. No integer SIMD/tiled optimization or public foreign-memory/wire API is introduced.

coverage: independent wider integer products and adjacent-pair reference tree
signed endpoints and values above float32 precision
1000 deterministic randomized shape/content cases per variant
fixed and dynamic shapes
odd and multi-level contractions, including 255/256/257/1025 terms
offset/noncontiguous and transposed borrowed input views
aliased operands
product overflow despite cancellation in final total
pair and later-level positive/negative overflow
late-cell faults publish no partial tensor
empty outputs, zero inner extent and valid huge unused inner extents
negative dimensions, byte-count overflow and dynamic inner mismatch before element access
scratch/output allocation failure and balanced releases
retained output cells after invocation settlement
poll-triggered in-loop cancellation without successful result publication
nested coordinator-created operands and cached awaits
tensor results retained after task/core/receiving invocation destruction
twelve task invocation allocation-failure positions
task cancellation/deadline signals and quota admission failure
Arithmetic recovery with unchanged parent tensor reuse and new parallel work
uncaught synchronous/task faults with original source location and clean settlement
private native boundary checks and Metal int32 capability gate
complete existing CPU/Apple Metal regression
qualification.optimized_task_runtime: Task observer links the existing optimized task-core archive.

distributed_execution: Not implemented; agreed design-review gate retained.
performance: Scalar correctness baseline; no integer matmul speedup or peak-throughput claim.
